stages.name: Garage
stages.blurb: A folding table, a box fan and a dream. Room for a handful of people.

stages.name: Office
stages.blurb: A real office floor with space for proper rooms.

stages.name: HQ building
stages.blurb: Our own building. Room for hundreds of people. (Multi-floor layouts come later; for now it is one big floor.)

rooms.name: Desk pod
rooms.blurb: Four desks. Everyone needs somewhere to sit.

rooms.name: Research lab
rooms.blurb: Six seats for researchers. They only boost training compute while seated in a lab.

rooms.name: Break room
rooms.blurb: Coffee, couches and a whiteboard. Keeps up to 20 people happy.

rooms.name: Server room
rooms.blurb: A cooled room for our own racks. Fill it with racks, cooling and power units.

rooms.name: Large server room
rooms.blurb: More floor for racks, cooling and power.

equipment.name: Rack
equipment.blurb: Holds 32 owned chips of one type. Needs power and cooling.

equipment.name: Power unit
equipment.blurb: Distributes 200 kW to the racks in its room.

equipment.name: Air cooler
equipment.blurb: Fans and vents. Removes 60 kW of heat.

equipment.name: Liquid cooling
equipment.blurb: Pipes and manifolds. Removes 250 kW and cuts the power bill.

equipment.name: Immersion tank
equipment.blurb: Chips bathe in coolant: removes 600 kW and holds 32 chips itself.
